reason: The code itself checks out on the machine lens: every opcode is real 65SC12 (EOR #, BRA). Recounted on the common path (no skeleton, no x carry), the +4 entry saves 3 cycles (one CLC, and BCS not taken at 2 instead of BCC taken at 3). The inlined path through check_for_player_collision_with_mover_Y saves 15 (those 3 plus JSR and RTS). Weighted 5.1 and 1.65 times a pass, that is 35 cycles a pass, about 6.9 an execution. The rare carry path costs 6 more. No table read crosses a page (&1300/&1322,X; &DA55/&DA71,Y with Y at most 127). Every new branch stays in its page, and both BEQs to check_for_collision_with_mover (&2577) and cfc_a_leave_clear are in range and in page &25. The +4 entry still lands on LDA movers_type_and_colour,X. C is 0 at both ADCs on every path. The size is +44 bytes as claimed (calc 44 -> 46, the Y routine 10 -> 52). The refutation is that growth. Built in scratch from HEAD with the candidate applied: the shipping, DEBUG_LIVES, gameplay and DEBUG_FULLREDRAW builds assemble, but the supported SKY_HELI=0 build (decision 36; CLAUDE.md and the Makefile name it: DEFINES=SKY_HELI=0) does not. In that build unused_3400_original has only 4 bytes left at HEAD (SKIP at &33FC). Baron reports 'layer 1's code overruns the free block by 40 bytes' (game.6502:5360), 'the start-up code carried in the save arena overruns it by 2', 'resident code and data overrun the screen by 2 bytes', and a kindcache.6502:43 assertion. HEAD builds SKY_HELI=0 cleanly. The gate's BUILDS (bench, full, ship, release) do not include SKY_HELI=0, so the gate would not catch this. The 44 bytes also move about 34 downstream branches across or off page boundaries (listing diff; e.g. BNE not_player_292b, BPL projectile_hit_mover and the leave_with_carry_set_30af group start crossing, the search_for_target_loop group stops crossing). That net is the optimiser's pcprof figure, which I did not reproduce.
